Name: Shamir, Son of Michah
Summary: Son of Michah son of Uzziel in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:24: Son of Michah son of Uzziel in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shamir stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
